intro: Judge seat for dimension D3, round 11, over the D3 wave verifier record (handoff/audit-r11-verify-D3W at 4bf6706bf7185b07185ebaaeac649f4252030671, 426 findings: verify 403, weaken 9, unresolved 14). Every finding is a production mutant (baseline 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692) that the full gate on its box did not kill, with a probe whose number moves under the one-line mutant. Ids stay D3-wave-<key> until the consolidation the d3wave plan rules (file and gap kind into D3-s1-72..99); each issue draft below lists its keys so that step can assign them.

sections.title: Measurement
lines: - Host: 8-core Apple silicon macOS, CPython 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.5, scipy 1.18.1 (the verifier's stack). Shared with other seats: load1 37-137 during the runs, so every number relied on is a count or a solver value; no timing is used. The probes pin BLAS threads to 1 and print thread_factor (1.000 on every row read).

- Probe re-run (judge.md step 1-2): all 426 probes re-run as their records' commands say (`harness/rerun.py`), in a worktree at the baseline with the D3 evidence copied over, each in a private TMPDIR; two-run probes (D3-g33) run plain and with `--mutant`. Output: `rerun/<key>.json`; reading: `harness/analyse.py` -> `analysis.json` (arm pairs parsed with the verifier's `v1_analyse.arm_pairs`, reused read-only; moved-count lines read directly; CPU-time lines dropped as volatile).

- Result: 426 of 426 exit 0. 423 move under their own perturbation with the null held; 3 do not (the D3-g35 sysid exact-float boundaries, below). 415 print RESULT lines identical to the verifier's recorded run; the other 11 are the D3-g45 thermal_model probes the verifier could not run (they need PROBE_ROOT; overlay: set to the worktree), which reproduce the finders' stated counts (e.g. 19404e36: 3936 of 17496 ordinary-dt inputs).

- Gate (not re-taken): a full gate is about 1 h per key on a quiet 4-core box; this host is shared at load 40-140, and the verifier recorded the same constraint. Instead every committed gate log was re-read against its box's null log (`harness/gatecmp.py` -> `gatecmp.json`): for all 426 keys no script failed that the null did not fail, and no script's `N of M ... FAILED` count is above the null's (36 keys in D3-g20/g30/g32/g34/g37 read 3 harness-header failures against a null of 4). Exact-text FAIL-line differences are self-test fixture lines with randomised names (a8:register_once), not checks. The null's three red scripts are named by each box's null-note (closure.py selftest merge-tool pins, entities.py's scoped-gate pin, harness_headers.py's D6 claims.py over the stripped docs); none reads a production file, and a kill by any of them would show as a raised count, which none shows.

- The verifier's open constraint (the null stays red on the unstripped tree, cause unverified) is not closed here: the record-level comparison above is what this judge relies on. Carry: R11-D3-JUDGE-GATE -- a quiet Linux box re-takes a sample of gates on a tree whose null is green before the fix groups claim a kill.
- Gate lease: not taken. The probes are counts in private temp roots and import nothing another run writes; the lease serialises stress.py's timing alone (dev/audit/README.md).

sections.title: Dedup
lines: Judge.md's rule, by measurement: for every ordered pair (A, B) of keys on the same production line (45 lines, 100 keys, 134 pairs), B's probe was run with B's one-line mutant text replaced by A's (`harness/cross.py`, code lines only, the copy deleted after). A merges B only when that run moves at least one of the arm pairs (or moved-input counts) B's own run moved, with B's null held (`harness/dedup.py`). 32 pairs move, 87 do not, 15 are not expressible (B's probe does not carry the mutant text literally). The canonical per line is the key moving the most others. Result: 22 merged, 404 canonical; `dedup.json` quotes each merge's number. Keys on different lines of one function were not merged: each line is its own unpinned guard, and no cross run was taken for them.

sections.title: Disputed and unresolved findings
lines: - Verifier weaken, accepted by consequence (high -> medium): ac6bedc7, 6aeb83e5, d06a2d8e, 4aac8e69, a66e1077.

- Verifier weaken, overturned to verified at the claimed medium: d943cc9f (the null's metric holds; only its log wording differs), 61e748f0 (the mutated line touches no divergent stub symbol; reachable). a3318879 merges into 61e748f0.
- b1a8d305: weakened to nit, hygiene: it moves only at p_total_max <= 0, below the options form's 1 kW floor (config_flow.py:1851).
- Judge re-grades of verifier-kept highs: d8101520 (published power_headroom value, no control reader) and 78b7f2eb (batch wood output, no plan change shown) -> medium.

- Unresolved D3-g45 (11): all re-measured here with PROBE_ROOT set; every one moves with its null at 0: 9 verified at the claimed severity, fdf5872f merged into 98853a54. beeb0683 and ea9c4705 move only at dt_hours < 1e-6 (0 of 17496 ordinary-dt inputs): kept low, hygiene.

- Unresolved D3-g35 (3): 64f3ef1f, d661d68f, 4da9d281 are void on this host (no input lands on the exact float boundary: hunt_hit 0, tau 200.00000000000887), so `unreproduced`, neither killed nor passed; a Linux x86 re-take is owed (Carry: R11-D3-JUDGE-LINUX). Even reproduced, an exact-equality boundary of a fitted parameter is a nit.

sections.title: Classes
lines: Every survivor is a production behaviour whose one-line mutation leaves the full gate green: the mechanism of I1 (`dev/audit/config/bugclasses.json`), reused, none minted. stop_rule_class by the number: bug where the moved value is medium or above (a plan, an actuation, a published or persisted value with consequence), hygiene for low and nit. RCA: owed for I1 (N far above 3; defect-root-cause.md), already standing under the class's open issue #3755.

sections.title: Issue drafts (not filed)
lines: `ISSUES.json`: one draft per owning production file, all class I1, each naming #3755 as the class issue so a filer appends rather than opening a second `[R11-I1]` title. The cut follows the seam a tests-only fix lands in (d3wave plan, follow-on step 5: carries onto the owning seam groups). Each draft lists its keys, gap kinds, severities and the judge's number.
